classification.difficultyReason: Translate each verbal specification into a triangle diagram, marking the right angle and reference angle and placing the given length on the correct side. This directly applies taught side definitions without calculating missing lengths or devising a construction method.

content.prompt: Draw diagrams of right-angled triangles with:

children.label: a
children.prompt: reference angle $30^{\circ}$ and the opposite side of length $8\text{ cm}$

answer.short: A right-angled triangle with a $30^{\circ}$ reference angle and the side opposite that angle labelled $8\text{ cm}$.
answer.worked: Mark the reference angle $30^{\circ}$ and the right angle. Label the side across from the reference angle $8\text{ cm}$.

spec.sourceRegion: Question 6(a); answer figure on teacher PDF page 40
spec.description: Right-angled triangle with a 30-degree lower-left reference angle and the opposite vertical side labelled 8 cm.
spec.mathematics: The labelled side is opposite the reference angle; the remaining acute angle is at the top.

children.label: b
children.prompt: reference angle $42^{\circ}$ and the adjacent side of length $5\text{ cm}$

answer.short: A right-angled triangle with a $42^{\circ}$ reference angle and its adjacent non-hypotenuse side labelled $5\text{ cm}$.
answer.worked: Mark the reference angle $42^{\circ}$ and the right angle. Label the side joining these two angles $5\text{ cm}$.

spec.sourceRegion: Question 6(b); answer figure on teacher PDF page 40
spec.description: Right-angled triangle with a 42-degree lower-left angle and adjacent horizontal side labelled 5 cm.
spec.mathematics: The labelled leg lies between the reference angle and the right angle.

children.label: c
children.prompt: reference angle $40^{\circ}$ and the hypotenuse of length $10\text{ cm}$

answer.short: A right-angled triangle with a $40^{\circ}$ reference angle and the hypotenuse labelled $10\text{ cm}$.
answer.worked: Mark the reference angle $40^{\circ}$ and the right angle. Label the side opposite the right angle $10\text{ cm}$.

spec.sourceRegion: Question 6(c); answer figure on teacher PDF page 40
spec.description: Right-angled triangle with a 40-degree lower-left angle and sloping hypotenuse labelled 10 cm.
spec.mathematics: The hypotenuse is opposite the right angle.
